⭐ Classic City Landmark Route— Ride any section, no need to complete the full route
🏯

Wenshu Monastery → Wuhou Shrine: Classic City Landmark Ride

📏 15-18 km⏱ ~2-3h (with stops)
★☆☆☆☆Beginner Leisure
City Landmarks

Route: Wenshu Monastery → Chenghua Park → Chengdu 339 (TV Tower) → Dongfeng Bridge → Chunxi Road → Tianfu Square → People's Park → Kuanzhai Alley → Qintai Road → Qingyang Palace → Du Fu Thatched Cottage → Huanhuaxi Park → Wuhou Shrine (13 iconic landmarks)

Why this route: The ultimate Chengdu city highlight ride — every stop is a must-visit landmark. Start from the Buddhist tranquility of Wenshu Monastery, pass through the neon-lit 339 TV Tower, shop at Chunxi Road, stroll the historic Kuanzhai Alley, pay homage to the poet Du Fu, and end at the legendary Wuhou Shrine. Ride any section you like — you don't need to complete the entire route!

Bike Rental Guide

Two ways to get a bike: shared bikes for quick trips, or rental shops for mountain bikes, road bikes, and full gear.

📱

Shared Bikes — Quick & Cheap

Scan-to-ride bikes available everywhere in Chengdu. Best for short city rides and greenway trips.

🚀 Shared Bikes Are Getting Better!

Chengdu's shared bikes are constantly upgrading. Newer models now feature:

🪟 Suspension Fork 🪑 Seat Suspension 📱 Phone Mount 🥤 Cup Holder ☁️ Zero-Pressure Cloud Seat 🦠 Antibacterial Handlebars

Also look out for Electric Shared Bikes (⚡ pedal-assist, great for long greenway rides!) and Limited Edition Purple & Pink bikes 💜💗 — super cute and perfect for photos!

  • No deposit required for foreign passport holders
  • Always park in designated zones (blue zones on the app map)
  • Red zones = no parking — you'll be fined
  • Weekday, weekend, and holiday pricing may differ — check the app before riding

📋 Shared Bike Riding Essentials

🗺 Map Rules

Designated Parking: Park within designated zones. Bike must be vertical within marked lines, front wheel facing the same direction as others.

Parking Zone (P Point): Blue "P" icons on the app map indicate valid return areas. Open the app map to find the nearest P point.

No-Parking Zone: Red areas on the map = no parking allowed. Parking here triggers fines (¥1–20). Never park in red zones!

How to Find a Parking Spot: Open the app map — blue P points are your return targets. Always check parking availability near your destination before starting a ride.

🔒 Lock & Return

How to Unlock: ① Scan QR code on the bike frame, or ② Manually input the vehicle number in the app. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled.

Scan Fails to Unlock: Check: mobile network is stable, Bluetooth is on, QR code is clean and undamaged. Try restarting the app.

Temporary Lock: Tap "Temporary Lock" in the app during a ride. Note: billing continues while the bike is temporarily locked.

How to Lock & Return: ① Park bike vertically within marked lines, ② Manually close the smart lock until you hear a "beep", ③ Wait for the app to show "Return Successful".

Cannot Lock: Possible reasons: not in a designated P zone, bike not parked vertically, poor network signal, or smart lock malfunction. Move to a P point and retry.

Forgot to Lock: Contact customer service immediately! Provide the vehicle number and location — they can remotely lock the bike for you.

Ride Not Ending After Lock: Wait 1–2 minutes. If the ride still hasn't ended, restart the app or contact customer support.

Phone Dead / Lost: Borrow someone's phone to log into your account, or contact customer support with your ID information to resolve the issue.

🔧 Vehicle Malfunction

Breakdown During Ride: Stop immediately in a safe place. Tap the "Report Repair" button in the app, or contact customer support directly.

Repair Reporting Process: ① Tap "Report Repair" → ② Select fault type and take a photo → ③ Submit and switch to another bike. Fees for the faulty ride can be appealed.

Fee Appeal: Go to "My" → "Trip History" → select the order → "Fee Appeal" → fill in reason and submit. Customer service processes within 1–3 business days.

Credit Score: Used to regulate riding behavior. Illegal parking will deduct points and may affect your ability to use the service.

Customer Support: In-app: "My" → "Customer Service Center". Each app has a hotline. 24/7 support available.

🚇+🚲

Metro + Shared Bike: The Ultimate Chengdu Combo

Chengdu's metro network spans 14+ lines covering the entire city. Take the metro to skip the heat and traffic, then hop on a shared bike right at the station exit to reach your destination's doorstep. The perfect summer strategy!

🚇
Step 1: Ride Metro
Take the air-conditioned metro to skip the hot streets. Chéngdū metro covers all major areas.
🚲
Step 2: Grab a Bike
Scan a shared bike right outside the station. Meituan / Hello / Qingju bikes are everywhere.
📍
Step 3: Arrive Fresh
Ride the last 1–3 km to the scenic spot entrance. No sweating, no parking hassle!
❄️ AC Escape: Metro cars are fully air-conditioned — the coolest way to cross the city in summer (30–35°C outside!)
💳 One App for All: Alipay QR code works for both metro gates and shared bikes — no separate tickets needed
🗺 Bikes at Every Exit: Metro stations in Chengdu always have shared bikes parked at exits A–D — never walk far
🌳 Greenway Stations: Lines 1, 5, 6, 18 all connect to Tianfu Greenway hubs — bike straight from the station onto the greenway!
🕐 Metro Hours: 6:00–23:30 daily. Plan your return — last train varies by line and station
💡 Pro Move: Metro to the edge of the city → bike into the countryside. Best of both worlds — comfort + adventure!
🏪

Alipay & WeChat Guide for Foreigners

You need one of these to unlock shared bikes and pay for everything in Chengdu. Here's how to set them up.

💙

Alipay (支付宝)

  1. 1 Download "Alipay" from App Store / Google Play
  2. 2 Sign up with your phone number (international numbers supported)
  3. 3 Go to "Me" → "Bank Cards" → Add your Visa/Mastercard
  4. 4 Verify identity with passport photo (takes ~5 min)
  5. 5 Done! Scan QR codes to pay, unlock bikes, and more

Pro tip: Alipay supports English UI. Enable it in Settings → Language.

💚

WeChat (微信)

  1. 1 Download "WeChat" from App Store / Google Play
  2. 2 Sign up with your phone number (international numbers supported)
  3. 3 Go to "Me" → "Services" → "Wallet" → "Cards" → Add your Visa/Mastercard
  4. 4 Verify identity with passport (may take 1–2 business days)
  5. 5 Done! Use "Scan" to pay and unlock shared bikes

Pro tip: WeChat's UI is mostly Chinese. Use Alipay if you prefer English.

💡

Quick Tips

  • Both apps work with foreign credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex)
  • Transaction limit: ~¥3,000 per transaction for foreign cards
  • Set up at least 1 app before arriving in Chengdu
  • You need one of these to unlock shared bikes — no app, no ride
  • Alipay is recommended for foreigners due to English support
  • Both apps also work for: metro tickets, bus, taxis, food delivery, shopping

Safety Tips & Cycling Etiquette

Stay safe and respectful on Chengdu's shared cycling paths.

🚦

Speed Limit

20 km/h max on greenways. Slow down near children and pedestrians.

➡️

Keep Right

Always ride on the right side. Pass on the left with a bell ring or verbal warning.

⛑️

Helmet Guide

Helmets are recommended for shared bikes, road bikes, and mountain bikes. Helmets are mandatory for e-bikes.

🚫

No Side-by-Side

Don't ride two abreast. Keep the path clear for faster cyclists and pedestrians.

☀️

Sun Protection

Chengdu summers are humid (30–35°C). Sunscreen, sunglasses, and water are essential.

🌧️

Rain Warning

Summer thunderstorms are common. Greenways can be slippery after rain — ride cautiously.

🔋

Phone Battery

Your phone is your map, payment, and bike key. Carry a power bank for long rides.

🆘

Emergency

Police: 110 | Ambulance: 120 | English-speaking police hotline: 12367
